description: This file defines Express.js routes for session tracking, including CRUD operations, list retrieval with filtering, pagination, normalization of session data, and tenant enforcement.

methods.name: toNumber
methods.description: Converts various input types (Decimal128, string, number) to a plain JavaScript number, returning NaN if parsing fails.

methods.name: normalizeSessionDoc
methods.description: Normalizes session document fields to ensure numeric values are properly parsed and defaulted, especially total_cost, cost_history[].total_cost, and agent_costs.
